**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation burdening Bluefly:

- **§ 4.1 Charges** is purely mechanical — charges are specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms, with no pricing-parity or price-matching commitment from us.
- **§ 14.16 Freedom of Action** ("Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.") runs in the opposite direction from an MFN or exclusivity, expressly preserving our freedom to contract elsewhere.
- Full-text searches for "favorable", "favourable", "most favored", "best price", "competitive offer" and "discount" surfaced no parity language anywhere in the document.

This satisfies the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer). Noted for the negotiation file rather than as a deviation: IBM also grants us no MFN pricing, so best-pricing protection in our favour remains an open commercial ask if useful, but its absence is not flagged under this rule.
